text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone seeks victory, running with all 
their might.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(Going all out, giving every last drop of 
strength... A contest of true power. 
Exciting! And—)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
An utter and absolute victory!! As "the 
strongest of all"!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment—the crowd of over 100,000 
gathered at Nakayama Racecourse... froze.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...S-So strong...! I... I give up...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Without question, the strongest... 
Gentildonna has—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
My daughter. You make this father... 
tremble. Yet, why go that far—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...That Trainer, was it? Then it is 
precisely because of them... that she 
succeeded."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: ...! To the strongest of all—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Th-the winner is...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Gentildonna...!! What 
unbelievable strength, what an incredible 
Umamusume...!”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh. A bit late for that now, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce myself once more, 
everyone... I am Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your hard work as well. 
Honing such magnificent strength—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I would like to extend my heartfelt 
gratitude for helping my strengths shine 
so brightly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I've stood at the summit of them all! I 
am—the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: And so? Why is everyone... staying silent?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Give your applause. ...Go ahead, won't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A solitary person's applause rings out. 
After a beat, the rest of the crowd joins 
in—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Amidst the earth-shaking cheers, she 
flashed an extraordinarily charming smile.
